_comment: Toolchain pins for the sg13g2-vco smoke bench (scripts/run-vco-smoke.sh) and the CP/PFD benches (scripts/run-cp-dc.sh, scripts/run-pfd-sweep.sh, which also read the psp103 pin). Matches the sg13g2-vco repo's sim/pdk.json (IHP-Open-PDK v0.3.0, openvaf-r v24.0.1mob) except where 'differs_from_vco_repo' says otherwise. Read by scripts/run-vco-smoke.sh, which refuses a PDK whose model libraries do not hash to model_libs_sha256.

pdk.tarball_sha256_source: sg13g2-vco sim/pdk.json (from 2AMLogic/klayout-tools scripts/fetch-ihp-sg13g2.sh); not re-derived here: the installed PDK carries no revision marker, so the files the bench loads are pinned by hash instead

osdi.compiler: OpenVAF/OpenVAF-Reloaded v24.0.1mob (openvaf-r, linux-x86_64), same pin as sg13g2-vco
osdi.note: The compiled library is byte-identical to the prebuilt libs.tech/ngspice/osdi/mosvar.osdi shipped in the v0.3.0 tarball. It targets OSDI v0.4; ngspice-42 only supports v0.3 and cannot load it.

ngspice.minimum_for_this_bench: a build that loads OSDI v0.4 (ngspice-42 does not)
ngspice.differs_from_vco_repo: sg13g2-vco's sim/ records used ngspice-46; ngspice-46 was not obtainable on this host (the source URL 404s and no build is provisioned), so the bench ran on a ngspice-47 source build. Select the binary with NGSPICE=/path/to/ngspice.
ngspice.init: set ngbehavior=hsa (the PDK's compatibility mode; written by the script into a scratch .spiceinit)

psp103.note: The HV MOS models in cornerMOShv.lib are PSP103 and need this OSDI library (pre_osdi). It is the prebuilt library shipped in the PDK tree, hash-checked rather than recompiled: unlike mosvar it is not rebuilt here, so no openvaf-r is needed for the CP/PFD benches.
